description: This file exports various type definitions and functions related to context engines, including types, registry functions, legacy engines, delegation, and initialization functions.

methods.name: registerContextEngine
methods.description: Registers a new context engine implementation.

methods.name: getContextEngineFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory function for a specific context engine.

methods.name: listContextEngineIds
methods.description: Lists all registered context engine identifiers.

methods.name: resolveContextEngine
methods.description: Resolves a context engine instance by its ID.

methods.name: registerLegacyContextEngine
methods.description: Registers legacy versions of context engines.

methods.name: delegateCompactionToRuntime
methods.description: Delegates data compaction to the runtime engine.

methods.name: ensureContextEnginesInitialized
methods.description: Ensures all context engines are initialized.
